entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand. It's not working right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band?
The pulse tracking is completely off. I checked it against a real monitor and this thing is garbage. Look, can I get a return started or not?
I understand your frustration. So it sounds like it may be a technical fault. We can transfer you over to our technical support team, they're usually able to troubleshoot and fix...
No. I don't have time for that. I don't want to fix it. I just want my money back. Can you process a refund for me?
Okay, I understand you just want this resolved quickly. Let me just pull up your purchase details and our current policy. Can I get the order number, please?
It's VF78-9910-B. I got it 17 days ago.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. You received it on January 11th. Let me check the policy... yes, our system shows all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Yes. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can absolutely process that return for you right now. I've just initiated it on my end.
Okay, great. What do I do next?

A pre-paid return label has just been sent to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. And for the inconvenience, and because you're a VIP member, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future VeloFit purchase.
Fine. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
